shared_elements: paired figures arranged in mirror symmetry about a vertical axis
animal/bird heads worked into the design
curved boat-like or crescent element at the base
enclosing border frame around the composition
justification: Both surfaces show schematic human figures embedded in a symmetrical composition of interlacing ribbon-bands terminating in animal heads, with hatched infill inside outlined bodies and a curved boat-like element along the lower edge, which is a fairly specific stylistic correspondence. The biggest differences in depicted content are the subjects themselves: A shows two mirrored winged/beaked humanoids grappling within a single round frame, while B is a tall multi-register field with mounted riders and figures in an upper panel above a large knotwork beast/ship design, with no winged pair.
